Jammu and Kashmir Police Search Over 20 Locations in UAPA Case

Police in Sopore, Jammu and Kashmir, conducted search operations at more than 20 locations linked to the Jamaat-e-Islami. The searches were carried out as part of an investigation into a Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA) case. During the operation, documents, literature, and electronic devices were seized.
